name: Single account: RankIC, diversification, dynamic K and cash ablations
warmup: 2011 IC observations; 2010 prices. Every arm starts in cash at the first weekly signal of 2012.

ic.update: first weekly signal each calendar month
ic.allocation: positive mean daily RankIC, proportionally capped; no permanent fixed-weight blend
ic.fallback: retain previous weights if fewer than five positive factors meet minimum history; initialize five families each 20%, equal within family
ic.score: retain production two-stage family standardization; family budgets are sums of current nominal factor weights; candidates must have a valid original fixed score; adaptive missing family scores renormalize available family budgets instead of treating missing as zero

selection.covariance: pairwise sample covariance, 20% diagonal shrinkage, PSD eigenvalue clipping; correlations use unshrunk returns
selection.dynamic_rule: smallest complete K meeting diversification target; otherwise K20; never select K using past strategy return
selection.underfill: each chosen stock keeps 1/requested_K weight; unused slots stay cash
selection.missing_correlation: reject candidate if a required pair correlation is unknown

risk.rule: daily review of trailing returns of current intended equal-weight basket; multiply base target by clipped target_vol / estimated_vol; retain budget if history insufficient
risk.execution: weekly stock selection; extra risk-only trades when threshold and cooldown permit; next session close

execution: shared research_replay, adjusted-close fractional shares, sell first, cash scaled buys, missing quotes not filled
limitations: Retrospective experiment, not untouched out-of-sample or live approval.
No lot sizes, minimum commissions, actual tax schedule, limit-up/down queue or capacity simulation.
Original frozen PIT universe and factor cache inherit vendor financial revisions, incomplete historical industry coverage and cash-flow proxy limitations.
Daily five-session IC labels overlap; no independent-sample significance claim.
No parameter search or historical winner automatically adopted.
